title: Sahidica — Sahidic Coptic New Testament

citation: Wells, J. Warren, ed. Sahidica: A New Edition of the New Testament in Sahidic Coptic (2000–2006), as annotated by Coptic SCRIPTORIUM.
editorialMarkers: A standardised edition of the Sahidic New Testament meant for comparison with the Greek; the editor calls it a work in progress. Not for print or commercial use without permission. Where this witness does not carry a verse — Acts 8:37 and Mark 9:46 among them, verses absent from most early manuscripts — the edition marks the place rather than dropping the verse, and Wellspring writes every such mark the same way, as “[—]”, so that the gap is visible and the numbering stays true. That marker is the edition’s own and is reproduced here unchanged: it means the verse is not in this manuscript tradition, not that the text is unknown.
method: Verse text is the corpus’s bound groups (orig_group / <phr>) joined with spaces; loanwords the corpus marks as Greek, Hebrew or Latin are kept as spans (sp.loan) for Word study; no normalisation of spelling.
